skills.name: Rhapsody
skills.description: Granger immediately reloads his gun and fires continuously in the target direction, dealing 35<font color='#D58E1F'>( +70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> with each shot (deals 120 extra damage against Creeps).
skills.tips: It's a great combo using this skill to change your position in battle and using "Rhapsody" to deal high damage. As it highly increases the Hit Rate of "Rhapsody" and reduces the CD time of this skill.

skills.name: Rondo
skills.description:
Granger blinks in the designated direction, and his next 2 Basic Attacks deal extra 25% of damage in 5s. 
Each time <font color='#404495'>(Rhapsody)</font> hits an enemy hero, the CD of this skill will be reduced by 0.5s.
skills.tips: Regardless of whether you are in pursuit of an enemy or on the run, take good advantage of this skill to reposition in battle.

skills.name: Death Sonata
skills.description: Granger immediately reloads and fires a cannon shot in the target direction with the super cannon hidden in his violin case. The cannon shot will pass through Minions and explode upon hitting an enemy hero, dealing <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> equal to 80<font color='#D58E1F'>( +70% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 12% of the target's lost HP to enemies in the area and slowing them by 80%. Granger can fire the super cannon 3 times at the cost of 2 bullets per shot, and can move once in the target direction after each shot. When <font color='#404495'>(Death Sonata)</font> ends, its cooldown will be reduced by 15% for every 2 bullets remaining.
skills.tips: The "lucky" effect of Granger's 6th bullet is not limited to his basic attacks, but also work with his 1st skill and ultimate! Make sure you hit the enemies with the 6th bullet to deal massive damage no matter what!

skills.name: Caprice
skills.description:
Granger can load his gun with up to 6 bullets at a time. Each 6th bullet is guaranteed to Crit.
Granger's Basic Attack deals 50<font color='#D58E1F'>( +110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>, but he only gains 40% of his total extra Attack Speed.
skills.tips: Rhapsody is Granger's primary damaging dealing skill. The last bullet of this skill guarantees critical damage. So watch your aim to make sure the last bullet hits the target.

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.des: Unique Passive - Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s (8s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Since Granger is a hero with DPS skills and his sixth bullet guarantees critical damage, we recommend equipment items which provide Physical ATK, Crit Damage and CD Reduction as a core. Buy Berserker's Fury first for your Builds. The 40% Crit Damage Bonus is perfect for Granger's sixth bullet. Then, according to the actual situation, you can choose between Blade of Despair and Bloodlust Axe. The large amount of Physical Attacks added by Blade of Despair can ensure that Granger can kill the enemies through skill combo, while 20% Spell Vamp of Bloodlust Axe can strengthen his ability in lane. For the last equipment item, you can choose Endless Battle and Hunter Strike, with 40% CD Reduction and increased cast frequency of his skills.
